maddeler.e:
ارتضين (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَيْنَ (irtaḍayna) /ir.ta.dˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اُرْتُضِينَ (urtuḍīna) /ur.tu.dˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اِرْتَضِينَ (irtaḍīna) /ir.ta.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
